ctx.x: think that you'd know someone, in Paris?" And Luke said, "Yeh, sure, Arthur Briggs, he's a friend. and I know that he can make it."
So he arranged with Mr. Weir, who was the conductor of the orchestra for a rehearsal, to see whether -- you know.
So, I made the test, and apparently it was okay, and I was hired for the entire season. So I kept on at my job until my contract expired, and did this show.
